# Tal Paperin

> Fractional CRO and fractional VP of Sales for B2B companies, including B2B SaaS. Operator, not advisor. Week one: I find what's broken. Week two: you get the plan. Then I rebuild the sales engine and own the revenue number. I bring my own sales team (SDRs and account executives) and my own marketing team, led by a fractional CMO. 30-plus B2B companies rebuilt, $20M ARR managed last year, work across five continents. Most clients are in the US; also North America, Europe and APAC. Pricing is month-to-month, Advisor $2,000 to CRO Ownership $22,000, plus a performance share.

## Canonical site
- https://talpaperin.com/

## Legal entity
- KSW Solutions (https://ksw.solutions) is Tal Paperin's company and the legal entity behind talpaperin.com. Both sites describe the same fractional CRO practice, led by Tal Paperin.

## Services
- [Fractional CRO](https://talpaperin.com/services/fractional-cro): A fractional CRO who sits in the seat and owns your revenue number, strategy, team, pipeline and forecast, without a $250K full-time hire.
- [Outsourced Sales Teams](https://talpaperin.com/services/outsourced-sales): Outsource your B2B sales function: native-speaking SDRs and AEs, plus senior leadership, hired, trained and managed for you, without building it in-house.
- [Pay-Per-Meeting B2B Sales Meetings](https://talpaperin.com/services/pay-per-meeting): You pay for the B2B sales meetings we book, not emails or lists. We define your ICP, find the people, and put qualified meetings on your calendar.
- [Go-To-Market Strategy](https://talpaperin.com/services/go-to-market-strategy): A go-to-market strategy you can actually execute, including SaaS GTM. ICP, positioning, channels, playbook and a real forecast, then I help you run it.
- [Fractional CMO and Marketing Leadership](https://talpaperin.com/services/fractional-cmo): Senior marketing leadership on demand: senior oversight or full fractional CMO ownership, so marketing and sales run as one revenue engine.
- [International Market Entry and Global Markets](https://talpaperin.com/services/market-entry): Break into new markets without the expensive mistakes. I have built sales, teams and subsidiaries across five continents. How I pick a market and win it.
- [Sales Team Building and Training](https://talpaperin.com/services/sales-team-building): Build your in-house sales team that actually closes. I hire, train and manage SDRs, AEs and BDs, and replace who can't.
- [Distributor and Channel Partner Recruitment](https://talpaperin.com/services/distributor-channel-recruitment): Open new territories through the right distributors and channel partners. I recruit, sign and manage them for the long term.
- [B2G and Public-Sector Sales](https://talpaperin.com/services/b2g-public-sector): Win complex government and public-sector deals. RFIs, RFQs and B2G projects across the globe, run by someone who has actually closed them.

## Blog posts
- [If Your Company Might Only Last Six Months, Your Sales Math Changes](https://talpaperin.com/blog/sales-math-when-runway-is-short): A CTech opinion argues your next business might last six months, and that can be enough. If that is the bet, sell for fast payback, not distant lifetime value.
- [When the Channel That Feeds You Changes, Your Revenue Is Exposed](https://talpaperin.com/blog/when-your-distribution-channel-shifts): AI is changing how hotels reach travelers, and a $25M round followed. If one channel feeds most of your revenue, you do not own your demand.
- ["A Culture of Failing to Keep Promises" Is a Sales Problem](https://talpaperin.com/blog/overpromising-kills-companies): An investor described Sapiens as having a culture of failing to keep promises. That starts in sales, when reps oversell to hit quota and delivery pays.
- [40 Companies, One Category, 20 of Them Israeli. How Do You Sell?](https://talpaperin.com/blog/selling-in-a-crowded-category): Nikesh Arora counts 40 firms racing to secure AI agents, at least 20 Israeli. When the category is a knife fight, the deck does not win. The sales motion does.
- [Debt Does Not Kill Companies. Soft Revenue Plus Debt Does.](https://talpaperin.com/blog/debt-plus-soft-revenue-kills-startups): Analysts warn that debt could amplify the damage AI does to businesses. The real risk is debt stacked on revenue that was never durable. Fix the revenue first.
- [HubSpot Cut 660 Jobs and Called It AI. Read It Differently.](https://talpaperin.com/blog/ai-layoffs-expose-weak-sales): HubSpot cut nearly 660 jobs and HoneyBook cut 14%, both blamed on AI. The honest read: AI gave cover to trim headcount a weak sales engine had carried.
- [At-Bay Was Valued at $1.35B. It Sold for $575M. Read the Gap.](https://talpaperin.com/blog/valuation-is-not-a-business): At-Bay hit a $1.35B valuation and sold to Munich Re for $575M. A valuation is a bet. Revenue is a fact. Here is how founders should read the difference.
- [Product-Led vs Sales-Led Growth: Which Does Your B2B Need?](https://talpaperin.com/blog/product-led-vs-sales-led): PLG fits low-ACV self-serve products. Sales-led fits high-ACV committee buying. Most B2B need a hybrid. Choose by buyer, price, and complexity, not by hype.
- [The Sales Metrics Founders Should Actually Track](https://talpaperin.com/blog/sales-metrics-founders-should-track): Founders drown in dashboards. Here are the five sales metrics that predict revenue, the vanity numbers to ignore, and when each one should make you act.
- [In-House SDRs vs Outsourced: What Early-Stage B2B Should Do](https://talpaperin.com/blog/sdr-in-house-vs-outsourced): In-house SDRs give control but are slow and costly to build. Outsourced and pay-per-meeting give speed and results-based cost. Here is how to choose by stage.
- [How to Write a Cold Email That Actually Books Meetings](https://talpaperin.com/blog/cold-email-that-books-meetings): Most cold email fails because it leads with the product. Here is the framework I use to write short, relevant emails that book real B2B meetings.
